hypothesis: Keep the corpus-pretrained backward policy fixed as the task-independent reverse-trajectory reference during online trajectory-balance replay, so score-dependent balance corrections are assigned to the proposal-generating forward policy, apart from the scalar partition normalization, instead of being partly absorbed by a reverse policy that never generates proposals.
method_thesis: Learn a task-agnostic forward and backward molecular-construction policy from the allowed unlabeled corpus using an atom-and-fragment graph grammar, then restart that policy independently for each objective. From an empty graph, the forward policy samples chemically valid attachment, bond, and stop actions until it produces a terminal molecule; whole corpus molecules are never retrieved, ranked, or used as a finite candidate pool. After each evaluator-announced batch is scored, map each observed score to a strictly positive tempered terminal reward and train on only oracle-evaluated molecules and their sampled construction/deconstruction trajectories using the trajectory-balance loss, a learned partition function, and reward-prioritized replay. Because trajectory balance assigns terminal probability according to total flow across every construction route rather than merely increasing the likelihood of one elite sequence, online feedback amortizes search into a de novo sampler whose probability mass concentrates on high-reward molecular regions while continuing to expose distinct routes to rare high-scoring structures. The optimization target remains the mean final Top-1 across the five independent sessions; flow statistics and replay usage are mechanism evidence, not substitute objectives.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: direct sampling from a tempered reward-proportional terminal flow distribution
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline unlabeled construction-policy pretraining followed by online off-policy trajectory-balance updates on reward-prioritized evaluated trajectories
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: trajectory-balance forward-policy sampling of complete molecular graphs from an empty root
method_tags.representation: partial molecular graphs built with atom and attachment-aware fragment actions

research_intent.falsifier: The mechanism is falsified if any backward-policy parameter changes during an Objective Session, or if freezing that policy does not increase the update-weighted reward-conditioned forward-probability contrast above the Parent value of +0.0010893032966897653; a non-finite balance residual, loss of finite reverse support, or failure of the existing line search to accept updates would also falsify the claimed fixed-reference credit assignment.
research_intent.implementation_change: After loading the prepared forward and backward policies, disable gradients only for the backward policy and keep it in evaluation mode throughout the Objective Session. In each existing line-searched trajectory-balance update, optimize the forward-policy parameters and learned log-partition parameter against the unchanged backward log-probabilities; retain the reward transform, prioritized replay, routes, update counts, line-search acceptance rule, sampling, novelty filtering, terminal zero-update repair, and protocol behavior. Extend the existing activation diagnostics to report backward-policy parameter drift without changing decisions.

research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Algorithm Node n-3cbb94a9ba13 completed seed 0 with macro mean 0.219194431541002, but zaleplon_mpo, deco_hop, and median_2 never improved on their fixed initial Top-1, while drd2_docking and sitagliptin_mpo improved by only 0.02200155723811 and 0.031510045255353. The unchanged learning evidence inherited from n-f316eae4e271 shows that every online trajectory-balance update reduced its replay loss, yet the Parent's update-weighted reward-conditioned forward-probability shift is only +0.0010893032966897653 and remains negative on median_2 and sitagliptin_mpo. Because proposals are sampled only from the forward policy while the current joint loss can also spend task-local correction on the backward policy, successful residual reduction is not producing a strong or consistent reward-directed change in the proposal distribution.
